[[Dahgar, the Eye of Flame]] is a [[boss]] who you are required to kill during the quest [[Then and Now, Here and There]]. He was Gwen's tormentor when she was captured by the Charr after [[the Searing]].

*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Ascalon]]

==Dialogue==
The Flight North:
:''Come grovel before me. Beg for your life. Show me the desperation in your eyes. No. None of that shall help. I simply wish to savor your fear.''
